vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: inventory-reorder-calculator
Version: 1.0.0

The inventory-reorder-calculator skill bundle is a purely instructional tool designed to guide an AI agent through e-commerce inventory management calculations. It contains no executable code, network requests, or suspicious prompt injection patterns, and its files (SKILL.md and output-template.md) are limited to defining workflows and output formats for inventory analysis.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only calculator for reorder points and suggested quantities; its declared inputs and instructions match the stated purpose and it requests no credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (inventory reorder calculation) aligns with the content: SKILL.md describes inputs (stock, sales, lead time, MOQ, safety stock), steps, and an output template. Nothing requested or referenced is unrelated to inventory calculations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are confined to taking inventory/sales/lead-time assumptions, computing reorder point and suggested quantities, and producing a structured output. The skill only references its included output template and does not instruct reading system files, contacting external endpoints, or accessing credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer, so there is minimal installation risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The inputs it asks for are domain data (inventory, sales, lead time) and are proportional to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there are no special privileges requested. disable-model-invocation is default (false) which is normal; the skill does not request persistent system-wide changes or access to other skills' configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only calculator and appears coherent with its stated purpose. Before using, verify the numerical assumptions you supply (avg sales, lead time variability, safety stock) because output quality depends on input accuracy. There are no credentials requested and no network calls in the provided instructions, but if you plan to integrate this with real inventory systems you'll need connector code/credentials outside this skill — review any future connector's permissions before granting access. If you need automated runs against live data, prefer a code-backed skill or connector that you can audit; for ad-hoc calculations, it's safe to use with non-sensitive example data.
